Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game and India Women Under-19 have sailed into the Super 6s stage of the competition. Scotland Women Under-19 though will play a playoff match and are still not out of the competition yet. You can catch the Super Six action for the India Women Under-19 matches beginning on Saturday, the 21st of January. You can also switch tabs and check the fixtures list to stay on top of the coverage. Cheers!

The captain of India Women Under-19, Shafali Verma says that the pitch was a bit slow and the ball was not coming onto the bat. Adds that the bowlers used the conditions really well. Mentions that it was a team decision to shuffle up the batting order as they wanted to give confidence to every player before going into the next stage.

Scotland Women Under-19 skipper, Katherine Fraser says that their innings just fell apart unfortunately. Adds that the nerves and the pressure got the better of them and they haven't played much cricket against the big sides. Mentions that they have enjoyed playing at this venue and look forward to their playoff match.

Mannat Kashyap (4-0-12-4) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her match-winning effort with the ball. Mannat says that it was a good feeling bowling on this wicket. Adds that it was turning a bit and but not as much as she expected. Mentions that there was no pressure on her to perform as she has the backing of the team.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Shafali Verma opted to bat first on a pitch that was used and wasn't the best for batting and it showed. India Women Under-19 found it difficult to get the ball away and a shuffle in the batting order didn't help either. Gongadi Trisha though made full use of her opportunity to open the innings and made a solid half-century. It was then, the in-form batter Shweta Sehrawat who played a blistering cameo towards the end that helped India set a target of 150 runs. For Scotland Women Under-19, the bowlers bowled well in general with skipper Katherine Fraser ending up with a couple of wickets. Onto the chase then and after a solid start from the openers, Scotland Women Under-19 were overwhelmed by the quality Indian spinners and succumbed to a big loss.

Scotland Women Under-19 will feel they let go of the opportunities presented to them in this game, both with the bat as well as with the ball. The openers, Ailsa Lister and Darcey Carter started off well and were able to get the boundaries inside the Powerplay but as soon as Lister fell, things started to fall apart. No one that came in even got to double figures apart from the openers with Carter top-scoring with 24 runs. Their batters had no answers for the Indian spinners and will be disappointed to have lost all their games so far.

After that late flourish from Shweta Sehrawat with the bat, India Women Under-19 did have momentum with them heading into the break. But the pacers, Titas Sadhu and Yashasri didn't start off well. It was only when Mannat Kashyap was brought into the attack that India were able to pick up wickets. The fielding in the early stages wasn't up to the mark either but Kashyap and Archana Devi simply ran through the Scotland Women Under-19 batting line-up with the former picking up 4 wickets and the latter ending with 3. All the wickets went to the spinners barring the run out as Sonam Yadav too picked up a couple of wickets. It was clinical in the end from India.

India Women Under-19 have overpowered Scotland Women Under-19 to make it three wins out of three and head into the Super 6s stage of the competition unbeaten. They do look like a side on a mission and will now look to carry the same momentum in the next stage of the competition.

OUT! TAKEN! Scotland Women Under-19 have been bowled here! Sonam Yadav flights this up around off, Orla Montgomery slashes at it across the line, but only manages to get an top edge as the ball loops up in the air. Gongadi Trisha at covers gets under it and takes a dolly. India Women Under-19 win by 83 runs and maintains their perfect record!
Commentary.Howout: c Gongadi Trisha b Sonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Looped up, full and on off, Niamh Robertson-Jack knocks it towards short covers. Archana Devi finish a fine spell with figures of (4-0-14-3).
Niamh Robertson-Jack is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Archana Devi gets her third wicket now and India Women Under-19 are just a wicket away from victory. Nicely tossed up again outside off and the ball turns away nicely as well. Nayma Shaikh looks to reach out and drive but gets a faint outside edge on it. Richa Ghosh at first slip pouches it safely with both hands and the resistance from Shaikh comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Archana Devi

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and around off, this is punched away off the back foot toward covers for a single.

FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up, a bit shorter and on off stump. Orla Montgomery goes deep in her crease and jabs it away behind square leg for a boundary. The fielder in the deep made a diving effort to her right but it wasn't enough.
Looped up, on a length and turning in from outside off. Orla Montgomery watchfully keeps it out.
Just short! Flights it up full and outside off. Nayma Shaikh looks to play the lofted drive but ends up slicing it in front of a diving Gongadi Trisha at point. They collect a single.
Floated up on off stump, Orla Montgomery defends it out.
Orla Montgomery comes out to the middle now.

OUT! STUMPED! Hrishita Basu with lightning-quick hands and Sonam Yadav gets into the wickets column as well. Nicely flighted delivery, on a nagging length and outside off. The batter, Niamh Muir id drawn forward and is undone in the flight as well as with the ball turning away. Muir dragged her back foot outside the crease and Basu dislodges the bails.
Commentary.Howout: st Hrishita Basu b Sonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: On off stump, this is eased away on the off side for a single.
Flatter one, turning into the pads, Nayma Shaikh nudges it out on the leg side.
That kept really low! This is on a nagging length and around off, the ball turns in and almost dies on its way to the keeper. Nayma Shaikh is beaten all ends up.
Flatter delivery on a shorter length and close to the off pole, Nayma Shaikh keeps it out on the off side.
Sonam Yadav has been introduced into the attack now.
On a length around off, Niamh Muir blocks it out.

Excellent effort from Archana Devi! This is floated up around off, Nayma Shaikh looks for the slog but gets a top edge that goes up in the air and over the bowler's head. Archana Devi runs back and puts in the dive but fails to get to it. Just the single.

Tossed up around middle, Niamh Muir lofts it high and towards long on. The long on fielder comes in and runs to her left but is beaten by the turn. The long off fielder tidies up and they only get a single.
Niamh Muir walks out to bat now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Excellent bit of fielding from Soniya Mendhiya and India Women Under-19 get their seventh wicket. Archana Devi flights it up on a length and outside off. Nayma Shaikh cuts it late to the right of the fielder at backward point and they try to scamper through. Mendhiya over there dives to her right and is quick to throw the ball back to the keeper. Hrishita Basu fails to collecvt the ball cleanly but it richochets back onto the stumps and even the dive couldn't save Maryam Faisal.
Floated up on middle, Maryam Faisal slogs it over the fielder at short mid-wicket and picks up another single.
In the air...safe! This is tossed up around off, Nayma Shaikh gets under it and lofts it high but the ball lands well in front of the fielder at long on. They get a single.

Drinks! Right then, Scotland Women Under-19 are struggling big time with the bat here and haven't been able to put up any sort of a fight against the Indian spinners. With 95 still needed to win off 60 balls and just 4 wickets in hand, the game is all but done and Scotland need a miracle here. Shafali Verma would want more of the same from her bowlers and would look to seal the win at the earliest.
This is bowled quicker and shorter around off. Nayma Shaikh goes for the pull and manages to clear mid-wicket. They get a single.
Switches to around the wicket now and tries to slide it across the left-hander. Nayma Shaikh slogs it away through mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.
Flighted delivery, on a length and turning in from outside off, Nayma Shaikh rocks back and nudges it down to backward point.
This is tossed up full and on off stump, Nayma Shaikh keeps it out.
Nayma Shaikh comes in at number 8.

OUT! PLUMB IN FRONT! Mannat Kashyap is running havoc here! She bowls this flatter, full and on middle, Emily Tucker goes down and tries to sweep it again, but misses and gets hit on the pads right in front of the stumps. There is another huge appeal, and up goes the finger. Scotland Women Under-19 six down now! Can Mannat Kashyap get a five-wicket haul here? She has four deliveries to do that.
DROPPED! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Emily Tucker slogs it in the air towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder runs forward and dives in but spills it out. Two runs taken!
Shortish and on middle, Maryam Faisal turns it to the leg side.

Archana Devi almost gets two in two here! This is tossed up, full and on off, Maryam Faisal drives it uppishly towards the bowler where Archana Devi dives forward and grabs it. However, the angle is not great for the umpires and after a discussion, they give it 'Not Out'. The replays shows that it was a clean catch.

Is that a clean catch? Archana Devi seems to have held on to a catch off her own bowling but the umpires come together and have a chat. They signal it Not Out but the replays show that it might have been a clean catch. The umpires sadly, don't have the additional replays to work with.
Maryam Faisal is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Scotland Women Under-19 are losing their way here. They look really uncomfortable against spin. Archana Devi floats this one up, touch fuller and on off, turing in, Olivia Bell opts to work it away on the back foot, but misses and gets rapped around her pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW, and up goes the finger. Olivia Bell is not happy with the decision, but has to walk back to the hut.
Floated, full and on middle, Emily Tucker slog-sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single. 50 up for Scotland Women Under-19!
Flighted, short and outside off, turning away, Emily Tucker misses her cut.
Tossed up, full and on off, Emily Tucker knocks it to the right of the bowler.
Short again and on off, Olivia Bell guides it towards point.
Slightly shorter in length and outside off, Olivia Bell tries to steer it, but fails to connect.
Looped up, full and on off, Olivia Bell looks to drive it away, but misses.
Short and on off, Olivia Bell pushes it towards short covers.
Olivia Bell comes out to bat with Scotland Women Under-19 in a spot of bother.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Another one bites the dust! Mannat Kashyap gets her third wicket. She flights this up, full and around off, Katherine Fraser moves across to paddle it away, but only manages to ge an bottom edge as the ball goes and rattle the off pole. It is all going downhill for Scotland Women Under-19 after a good start.
Floated, full and on middle, Emily Tucker lofts it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Gives this some air, on middle, turning in, Katherine Fraser keeps it out to the leg side.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Emily Tucker lobs it towards long on for a single.
Emily Tucker is in at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! Spin does it again for India Women Under-19! Darcey Carter's decent knock comes to an end now. Archana Devi floats this up, full and around off, Darcey Carter goes for the slog, but fails to get under it and hits it in the air towards long on. Titas Sadhu there runs forward and takes a nice catch. She makes it look easy, but it was a good catch. Scotland Women Under-19 three down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Titas Sadhu b Archana Devi

Commentary.Commentary: In the air..safe! Thsi is tossed up, full and on off, Katherine Fraser goes for the slog-sweep, but gets a top edge which goes just over the mid-wicket fielder. They cross.
Short and outside off, Katherine Fraser cuts it towards point.
Archana Devi starts with a looped up delivery, full and on off, Darcey Carter mistimes her drive towards mid on for a single.
Archana Devi is now brought into the attack.
Floated, full and on middle, Katherine Fraser knocks it to the leg side.
EDGED AND FOUR! This is tossed up, full and on off, Katherine Fraser looks to block it but gets an outside edge past the keeper and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Katherine Fraser walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Mannat Kashyap strikes again! Emma Walsingham goes back for a golden duck. Mannat Kashyap slows it up again and on off, turning away, Emma Walsingham tries to reach for it and hangs her bat there without going through the shot. The ball takes the outside edge and loops up towards covers where Gongadi Trisha takes a nice catch diving forward. Scotland Women Under-19 two down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Gongadi Trisha b Mannat Kashyap

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and on middle, Darcey Carter works it with the inner half towards square leg for a single.
Looped up, full and outside off, turning away, Darcey Carter goes for the big shot again, but fails to connect.
Tossed up, full and on off, turning away, Darcey Carter makes room and swings through the line but misses.
This is bowled into the deck and over middle and leg, Darcey Carter backs away and goes hard at it but mistimes it over mid-wicket. The ball lands safely and they pick up a single.

NO BALL! Pitched up again but in that channel around off and there's some away movement as well. Darcey Carter looks to play at it but is well beaten. Yashasri though has overstepped and it will be a no ball. Free Hit to follow...
FOUR! Streaky boundary! Pitched up around middle, Darcey Carter goes for the heave but gets an inside edge that runs away fine and past the fielder at short fine leg for a boundary.
On a good length and bowled around middle and leg, Darcey Carter defends it out.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, Darcey Carter clears the front leg again and swats it in between mid off and extra cover to pick up another boundary.
SIX! BOOM! Yashasri goes a bit full and pitches it up around off stump. Darcey Carter clears the front leg and swings through the line of the ball. The ball flies over the long off boundary.
Just short! This is banged in short and around off, Darcey Carter gets stuck on the crease and fends at it awkwardly. The ball pops off the blade but lands well in front of Shafali Verma at mid off.
Emma Walsingham walks out to bat now. Also, Yashasri is back on.

OUT! CAUGHT! The change of pace has worked for India Women Under-19. This is nicely tossed up by Mannat Kashyap, around off and turning away. Ailsa Lister looks to get under the ball and loft it with the turn over mid off. The ball is miscued high in the air and lands around the cover region. Shweta Sehrawat settles under it and takes a safe catch/. Scotland Women Under-19 lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Shweta Sehrawat b Mannat Kashyap

Commentary.Commentary: Ailsa Lister pre-meditates and moves past the stumps, Mannat Kashyap smartly pushes it even wider and once again the cross-batted shot is missed by Lister.
Nicely bowled! This is a flighted delivery bowled well outside off. Ailsa Lister moves a long away across the off stump and tries to slog it away but misses.
This is floated up on middle and leg, Darcey Carter heaves it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket for a single.
And again! This is nicely tossed up outside off, Darcey Carter has a swipe across the line but is beaten by the turn yet again.
Beaten all ends up! Starts off with a loopy delivery well outside off. Darcey Carter looks to dispatch it over long off but the ball turns away and Carter is nowhere near it in the end.
Mannat Kashyap comes into the attack now,
On a length and around off, this is pushed away on the off side for one.
Here comes the yorker now, it is bowled right at the toes and Darcey Carter manages to keep it out.

DROPPED! Another chance goes abegging and India Women Under-19 haven't been at their best in this game. This is a bit short and wide, Darcey Carter slaps it straight to Richa Ghosh at point but the regular Indian keeper misses a simple chance to her left side. She tries to juggle it but the ball pops out.
Pitched up outside off, Ailsa Lister reaches out and plays a checked drive toward sweeper cover for a single.
WIDE! This is full and wide again, spilled beyond the tramline. Wide called.

SIX! Unreal timing on that shot and even Ailsa Lister herself cannot believe it. Good length outside off, Lister skips down the track and just plays a lofted drive over the cover fence and the ball travels a long way. New ball, please!
Drags it down now and bowls it outside off, Ailsa Lister pulls it straight down to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off, a bit too wide though for the umpire's liking.
Nicely bowled! On a fullish length and in that channel around off, Darcey Carter looks to play at it but is beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! A fraction shorter and outside off, Darcey Carter plays it late and taps it well behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Swing, and a miss! Around the top of off and nipping back in, Darcey Carter stays put and has a wild heave across the line but fails to get a connection.
Bowls it a touch fuller now and around off, Ailsa Lister moves around in her crease before punching it to the left of the cover fielder for a single.
Pacy delivery, hitting the length hard around off, Ailsa Lister manages to keep it out.
Starts off with a good-length ball on the body. Darcey Carter works it off her hips toward mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Yashasri to bowl from the other end.
Good length on the pads, this is tucked away toward backward square leg. 7 runs off the first over, a steady start for Scotland Women Under-19.
Pitched up around the fifth stump line and it is left alone for the keeper to collect.

Put down! Hrishita Basu spills a simple chance and Ailsa Lister gets an early life. Length ball on off, Lister shuffles and looks to scoop it over the keeper but gets an edge straight to the keeper. Basu is a bit late in reacting and ends up spilling it.
FOUR! Width offered and punished! This is a bit short and wide, Ailsa Lister throws her hands at it and slaps it in front of point for a boundary.
WIDE! Good take by Hrishita Basu behind the sticks. This is fuller and way down the leg side, Basu dives to her left and pouches it with her left glove.
Up and over! Good length again outside off, Ailsa Lister stays there and lifts it over the cover region for a couple of runs. Lister and Scotland Women Under-19 are underway.
Starts off with a good-length ball that angles in from outside off. Ailsa Lister stays watchful and taps it out in front of cover-point.
